battle.name: 魏騏驎起義
battle.brief: 大業十一年（615）十月丁卯，彭城人魏騏驎聚眾萬餘為盜，寇魯郡，隋朝在山東的郡兵不足以制止；同月北方突厥大困隋軍於雁門，關中兵又不能速平敬盤陀、柴保昌。卡面亞述長弓屬前七世紀兩河流域工藝，與此役相隔一千三百餘年；叛軍所用只是民間流傳的粗弓梟矢，官軍則仍恃弩、槊與明光鎧。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 這場衝突是隋朝末年山東、淮北一帶由「賊帥」率領的地方起義，在《隋書·煬帝紀》中只佔一行。交戰一方是隋朝及其在徐州、兗州一線的郡兵、縣兵與臨時募來討賊的將士：徐州治彭城，即今江蘇徐州；魯郡屬兗州，治曲阜，即今山東曲阜，兩地相距約二百公里，叛軍自彭城聚眾起事，旋即往西寇掠魯郡。另一方是魏騏驎所率的起義群眾，屬於隋末「盜賊」中最典型的一類：不是高句麗那樣的邊疆部族，而是被括戶、徵兵、徭役與饑荒擠出來的編戶丁壯、逃戶、逃卒與亡命之徒，聚集在彭城一帶的川澤山林之間，以聚眾為盜的方式生事。外部環境同樣重要：同年八月，突厥始畢可汗率騎數十萬謀襲乘輿，隋軍在雁門城連戰不利，煬帝下詔天下諸郡募兵，兵員與糧秣再被抽調；十二月朝廷才詔民部尚書樊子蓋發關中兵討另一路賊帥敬盤陀、柴保昌，經年不能剋。北方的高句麗、新羅與靺鞨在正月照例遣使朝貢，說明隋朝的對外秩序仍在，但朝廷已騰不出手收拾山東這一支。
countriesEn: This clash was a local rising led by a bandit chief in the mountains and marshes of Shandong and northern Huai in the last years of the Sui, and it occupies a single line in the annals of Emperor Yang of the Shi Shu. On one side stood the Sui state together with the county levies of the Xuzhou and Yanzhou circuits and the troops hastily recruited to hunt bandits: Xuzhou was administered from Pengcheng, present-day Xuzhou in Jiangsu, while Lu Commandery belonged to Yanzhou and was administered from Qufu, present-day Qufu in Shandong, about two hundred kilometres apart. The rebels gathered at Pengcheng and then moved west to raid Lu. The other side was the following of Wei Qilin, a typical Sui-era band of bandits: not a frontier tribe like Goguryeo, but registered able men, runaway households, deserters and fugitives squeezed out by the registration of households, by conscription, by corvee labour and by famine, who collected in the woods and marshes around Pengcheng and lived by gathering in numbers and raiding. The wider situation matters as much. In the eighth month the Qaghan of the Turks, Shibi, led tens of thousands of horsemen in a planned attack on the emperor's convoy; the Sui army fought badly at Yamen and the emperor ordered all commanderies to recruit, which drew away more men and more grain. Only in the twelfth month did the court order the Minister of Works, Fan Zigai, to lead the troops from Guanzhong against another pair of bandit chiefs, Jingtuo and Chai Baochang, and that expedition could not break them even after a year. In the first month of the year Goguryeo, Silla and the Mohe still sent envoys with tribute, so the external order of the dynasty was intact, but the court no longer had the strength to deal with this band in Shandong.
people: 魏騏驎是本場唯一留下姓名的首領，籍貫彭城，身份在史籍中只寫到「聚眾萬餘為盜」這一步，沒有官位、沒有爵號、沒有年齡，也沒有留下任何言行；他的名字之所以留在史書，只因為他這一支在同年十月確實動了兵、寇了郡。隋朝一方真正作決策的是煬帝本人：他在十一年內要處理的，是年初北平楊仲緒、齊郡顏宣政之亂，七月淮南張起緒舉兵、眾至三萬，八月雁門被突厥圍城而「官軍頻戰不利」，十月山東、淮南、江南同時出事，於是十二月把樊子蓋與關中兵派出去，卻仍舊「經年不能剋」。真正在戰場上拿下的，是一批被記錄在《隋書》本紀裡的地方將領：武賁郎將高建毗於正月破賊帥顏宣政於齊郡，滑公李景於二月破斬楊仲緒於北平，右禦衞將軍陳稜於次年九月擊破東海杜揚州、沈覔敵眾至數萬的起義；同一批將領也有敗績，隋朝將軍潘長文在次年四月討歷山飛部將甄翟兒時反被擊敗戰死。值得注意的是勸諫者與被斬者：奉信郎崔民象以「盜賊充斥」上表諫不宜巡幸，奉信郎王愛仁再以「盜賊日盛」請還西京，兩人都被煬帝盛怒斬殺；齊王暕在雁門之圍中以後軍保于崞縣，是隋室宗室中少數握有兵權者之一。
peopleEn: Wei Qilin is the only leader whose name this clash preserves. He was a native of Pengcheng, and the historical record takes him no further than gathering more than ten thousand men as bandits: no office, no title, no age, not a word attributed to him. His name survives only because his band in the tenth month of that year did take up arms and did raid a commandery seat. The man deciding policy for the Sui was the emperor himself. Within a single year Yang had to deal with the risings of Yang Zhongxu at Beiping and Yan Xuanzheng at Qijun in the early months, with Zhang Qixu raising three thousand men in Huainan in the seventh month, with the Turkic siege of Yamen in the eighth month in which the imperial troops fought badly, and with trouble in Shandong, Huainan and Jiangnan all at once in the tenth month; in the twelfth month he sent Fan Zigai and the troops of Guanzhong out, and they still could not break the enemy even after a year. The men who actually won the field fights are the local commanders named in the annals: the officer of the Guard of Valour, Gao Jianpi, defeated the bandit chief Yan Xuanzheng at Qijun in the first month; the Duke of Hua, Li Jing, cut down and killed Yang Zhongxu at Beiping in the second month; the Right Imperial Guard commander, Chen Leng, broke the rising of Du Yangzhou and Shen Midi in Donghai, whose numbers reached tens of thousands, in the ninth month of the following year. The same kind of commander also lost: the Sui general Pan Zhangwen was defeated and killed in the fourth month of the next year while marching against Zhen Zhai'er, who had revived the name Lishan Fei. What the record also preserves is the fate of the men who gave counsel. Cui Minxiang, an official of the Imperial Secretariat, presented a memorial saying that bandits filled the roads and that the emperor should not go on tour, and Wang Airen, an official of the same office, asked to return to the western capital because the bandits were multiplying daily; both were beheaded in the emperor's anger. The Prince of Qi, Yang Guang, kept the rear guard at Wuo county during the siege of Yamen and was one of the few members of the Sui imperial clan who ever held troops.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長弓屬前七世紀的兩河流域：木胎角背的複合弓身，配長箭與鐵鏃，亞述人用它建立了一整套以箭雨先手、鐵器破陣的征服術，弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。必須說清楚的是，它同615年山東的這場起義並無真實關係，兩者相隔一千三百餘年，亞述弓不可能出現在曲阜城下；但它恰好提供了一條有用的尺度：一件弓的技術門檻有多低，以及門檻降低之後意味著什麼。亞述時代的弓是帝國級壟斷，必須靠王室軍械庫裡的木料、角料與鍛造能力供應，數量有限、質量講究；到了隋代，同一門技術已經跌落成民間的粗弓——桑木弓、角弓，普通農戶自備，弦用麻或皮，箭以梟骨、柳木或桑木削成，鏃有鐵的、有銅的、也有磨石代用的，兩三張就能湊成一支能上樹、能伏擊、能打散隊形的游隊。弩的門檻要高得多：臂弩、檜弩、班弩與車弩有鐵臂或木臂並帶機括，隋廷列在武庫令內由官府製造發放，屬於官軍裝備的一部分，叛軍極難仿製。因此本役真正的分野在弓弩與器械的門檻：叛軍靠散兵游勇的粗弓與短刀、柴斧、梟矢，憑人數與流動性作戰；官軍的郡兵則以槊、橦盾、拒馬、鹿角、札甲與明光鎧組成，騎兵是打擊主力，攻城與野戰的器械如撞車、雲梯、飛石車、井車只掌握在中央調來的關中兵手上。糧秣與運輸同樣是分水嶺：起義群眾可以靠劫掠即時補給，郡兵卻要從州郡倉庫領糧，器械壞了要回武庫修補，弓弦斷了要重造。
kitsEn: The Assyrian bow on the card belongs to the seventh century BC in Mesopotamia: a composite bow of wood and horn, shooting long arrows with iron heads, which gave the Assyrians a whole art of conquest based on opening with a shower of arrows and breaking the line with iron, the archers shooting from the chariots and the chariots following the archers. It has to be said plainly that it has no real connection with this rising in Shandong in 615. The two are more than thirteen centuries apart and an Assyrian bow could not have stood before the walls of Qufu. What the card does supply is a useful measure: how low the technical threshold of a bow had fallen, and what that meant. In Assyrian times the bow was a monopoly of the empire, supplied from the royal arsenal with its timber, horn and forging capacity, in limited numbers and to a high standard. By the Sui the same craft had sunk into the rough bow of the countryside: mulberry and horn bows, owned by ordinary households, strung with hemp or hide, with arrows cut from owl bone, willow or mulberry, and heads of iron, of bronze, or even of ground stone standing in for metal. Two or three such bows would make a wandering band that could climb a tree, lie in ambush and break up a formation. The crossbow sat at a far higher threshold: the arm crossbow, the cypress crossbow, the repeating crossbow and the cart crossbow had iron or wooden stocks with a trigger mechanism, and the Sui listed them in the regulations of the Bureau of Arms, made and issued by the state, so they formed part of the equipment of the imperial troops and were almost impossible for a rebellion to copy. The real dividing line in this war was therefore the threshold of the bow, the crossbow and the siege machines. The rebels fought with rough bows, short swords, woodcutters' axes and fowled arrows, and relied on numbers and mobility. The county levies were formed of the shuo, the tower shield, the cheval-de-frise, the antler obstacle, lamellar armour and the polished bright breastplate, with cavalry as the striking arm, while the engines of war, the battering cart, the scaling ladder, the stone thrower and the well cart, were held only by the troops brought down from Guanzhong. Supply and transport were another watershed: the insurgents could replenish themselves on the spot by plunder, while the county levies drew rations from the commandery stores, sent damaged equipment back to the arsenal for repair and had to make new bowstrings.
tactics: 起義一方的戰術可以概括為散兵游勇、靠流動打消耗。魏騏驎這類「賊帥」多半不帶攻城器械，也不打算守城，聚眾之後先做的一件事，就是挑郡兵空虛、倉廩有糧的地方突入，掠完就走，靠速度與地形保持存在。魯郡治曲阜，是兗州治所，府庫、倉廩與孔廟都在城裡，叛軍寇魯郡，目標是糧食與財貨，而不在攻城本身；得手之後散入沂、泗、泰山之間的鄉里與山澤，靠村莊、樹林、河道遮蔽，官軍騎兵一到就散，騎兵一走又聚。官軍這邊仍是郡兵為守、募兵為戰的格局：郡兵守城守關，遇到「眾至數萬」的賊眾就閉門待援，真正追擊靠中央調來的可用兵力與名將，高建毗、李景、潘長文、陳稜都是率一支精兵作定點追剿，但兵到賊散、兵走賊復集。樊子蓋「經年不能剋」正說明這種戰術結構失效：對手不是一次會戰可以解決的敵軍，而是一個不斷重組的流動目標，行軍與糧道本身就是起義方最有效的武器。隋廷從關中、洛陽、冀州調兵去山東，路線愈長，回程愈難維持，而煬帝自己在本紀中留下的「官軍頻戰不利」，正是這種結構的註腳。此外，隋廷在失敗之後往往以刑罰代替戰事：同在本年五月，煬帝殺右驍衞大將軍李渾、將作監李敏並族滅其家；十月又記大流星如斚墜於賊帥盧明月營中、破其衝車，把天象與卜候之事也寫進了戰爭記錄裡。
tacticsEn: The tactics of the insurgents can be summed up as skirmishers who spent their strength in movement. Bandit chiefs such as Wei Qilin generally brought no siege engines and had no thought of holding a city. Once they had gathered, the first thing they did was to strike where the county levies were thin and the granaries were full, and then to move off, preserving themselves through speed and terrain. Lu Commandery was administered from Qufu, the seat of Yanzhou, where the treasuries, the granaries and the Confucian temple all stood inside the walls. When the rebels raided Lu, their object was grain and goods rather than the city itself. After a raid they dispersed into the villages and hills between the Yi and Si rivers and around Mount Tai, sheltering among hamlets, woods and river channels, scattering when the imperial cavalry arrived and reforming when it withdrew. On the Sui side the arrangement was still levies for defence and recruits for war: the county troops held cities and passes, and when faced with a host numbered in tens of thousands they shut the gates and waited for relief, while the actual pursuit depended on usable troops brought down from the centre and on famous commanders. Gao Jianpi, Li Jing, Pan Zhangwen and Chen Leng all led a picked force in point pursuits, but the bandits scattered when the troops came and re-formed when the troops left. The formula that Fan Zigai could not break in a year shows exactly how this structure failed: the opponent was not an enemy that a single battle could decide, but a moving target that kept re-forming, and marching and supply lines were in themselves the insurgents' best weapons. Moving troops from Guanzhong, Luoyang and Jizhou to Shandong meant longer routes and a harder return, and the annals' own verdict that the imperial troops fought badly is the footnote to that structure. The court also increasingly substituted punishment for battle: in the fifth month of the same year Yangdi put the Right Equerry General Li Hun and the Director of Works Li Min to death and exterminated their families, and in the tenth month the record notes that a large meteor fell into the camp of the bandit chief Lu Mingyue and broke down one of his war carts, so that even omens and divination were written into the record of the war.
data: 可核的數字全部出自《隋書·煬帝紀》與《資治通鑑》，而且多數是史家的概數，逐一標明其性質。第一是時間：大業十一年即615年，正月、二月、五月、七月、八月、九月都有事，涉本役的記錄在冬十月：十月壬戌煬帝至東都，十月丁卯「彭城人魏騏驎聚眾萬餘為盜，寇魯郡」。第二是規模：魏騏驎一軍「萬餘」是《隋書》留下的唯一人數；同年可作對照的數字有二月「賊帥揚仲緒率眾萬餘，攻北平」、七月「淮南人張起緒舉兵為盜，眾至三萬」、十月「賊帥盧明月聚眾十餘萬，寇陳、汝間」，二月「上谷人王須拔反，自稱漫天王，國號燕，賊帥魏刁兒自稱歷山飛，眾各十餘萬，北連突厥，南寇趙」（《資治通鑑》與戰爭一覽作魏刀兒），十二月「譙郡人朱粲擁眾數十萬，寇荊襄，僭稱楚帝，建元昌達」。第三是官軍的戰果與損失：正月「武賁郎將高建毗破賊帥顏宣政於齊郡，虜男女數千口」，二月「滑公李景破斬」楊仲緒；次年四月「將軍潘長文討之，反為所敗，長文死之」，九月「右禦衞將軍陳稜擊破」杜揚州、沈覔敵；八月雁門「突厥始畢可汗率騎數十萬」，圍城後「官軍頻戰不利」，九月「突厥解圍而去」。第四是背景量級：《資治通鑑》記第一次征高句麗「發兵百十三萬五千八百人」；《隋書》記大業九年楊玄感反於黎陽、眾十萬，餘杭劉元進「眾至數萬」，晉陵朱燮、晉陵管崇「擁眾十萬餘」，陳瑱眾三萬攻陷信安郡。第五是地理：彭城即今江蘇徐州，魯郡即今山東曲阜，兩地相距約二百公里，叛軍由彭城起事、往西寇魯郡。第六是卡面兵器：亞述長弓屬前七世紀工藝，與本役相隔一千三百年以上。
dataEn: Every verifiable figure comes from the annals of Emperor Yang in the Shi Shu or from the Zi Zhi Tong Jian, and most of them are the summary numbers of the historian, so each is labelled for what it is. First, the timing: the eleventh year of Da Ye is 615. There were events in the first, second, fifth, seventh, eighth and ninth months, and the entry for this war falls in the tenth month: on the renxu day of the tenth month the emperor reached the eastern capital, and on the dingmao day of the same month, Pengcheng man Wei Qilin gathered more than ten thousand men as bandits and raided Lu Commandery. Second, the scale: the single figure for Wei Qilin's force is the more than ten thousand of the Shi Shu. Comparable figures for the same year are the bandit chief Yang Zhongxu with more than ten thousand men attacking Beiping in the second month; Zhang Qixu of Huainan raising three thousand men as bandits in the seventh month; the bandit chief Lu Mingyue with more than a hundred thousand men raiding between Chen and Ru in the tenth month; in the second month the Shanggu man Wang Xuba revolted, styled himself Prince Man and took the state name of Yan, while the bandit chief Wei Diao'er styled himself Lishan Fei, each gathering more than a hundred thousand men, joining the Turks in the north and raiding Zhao in the south, the Tong Jian and the list of wars giving the name as Wei Dao'er; and in the twelfth month Zhu Can of Qiaozhou gathered several hundred thousand men, raided Jing and Xiang, and usurped the title of Emperor of Chu with the era name Changda. Third, the results and losses of the imperial side: in the first month the officer of the Guard of Valour, Gao Jianpi, defeated the bandit chief Yan Xuanzheng at Qijun and captured several thousand, in the second month the Duke of Hua, Li Jing, cut down and killed Yang Zhongxu; in the next year in the fourth month, when the general Pan Zhangwen moved against the force, he was defeated and died, and in the ninth month the Right Imperial Guard commander, Chen Leng, broke Du Yangzhou and Shen Midi. In the eighth month at Yamen the Qaghan of the Turks, Shibi, led tens of thousands of horsemen, and after the city was surrounded the imperial troops fought badly, the siege being lifted only in the ninth month. Fourth, the scale of the background: the Tong Jian records that the first campaign against Goguryeo mustered 1,135,800 men, and the Shi Shu that in the ninth year of Da Ye Yang Xuanggan rebelled at Liyang with a hundred thousand men, that Liu Yuanjin of Yuhang raised tens of thousands, that Zhu Xie and Guan Chong of Jinling gathered more than a hundred thousand, and that Chen Zhen's three thousand took Xinan Commandery. Fifth, the geography: Pengcheng is present-day Xuzhou in Jiangsu, Lu Commandery is present-day Qufu in Shandong, the two about two hundred kilometres apart, and the rebels rose at Pengcheng and moved west to raid Lu. Sixth, the weapon on the card: the Assyrian bow belongs to seventh century BC craft and stands more than thirteen centuries away from this war.
cause: 直接起因是大業十一年山東的社會崩解與兵力真空。八年之間三度征遼東，括戶、徵兵、興工、修運河，州縣的丁壯被一遍遍抽走；戶口逃離，田疇無人，倉廩空虛，饑饉與疫癘在泗、沂、泰山之間交替出現。這些人不是一下子變成賊的：大業九年楊玄感反於黎陽、眾十萬，劉元進起兵餘杭、眾至數萬，朱燮與管崇在晉陵擁眾十萬餘，陳瑱眾三萬攻陷信安郡——這一批被平下去之後，亂並沒有停止，只是從會戰型起義變成了分區盤踞、流動劫掠的「賊帥」模式，數量多而各自獨立。魏騏驎的起事正是這種模式的樣本：他自己不稱王、不稱帝、不設官署，只「聚眾萬餘為盜」，然後寇掠郡縣；同年年底司馬長安破西河郡、賊帥王須拔破高陽郡、盧明月十餘萬寇陳汝，都是同一種樣本。隋廷對此的辦法是徵發：八月雁門圍城之際詔天下諸郡募兵，十二月命樊子蓋發關中兵討敬盤陀、柴保昌，結果「經年不能剋」。募集與徵發令郡兵愈虛、倉廩愈空，地方只要出現一個敢聚眾的人，就會有流民、逃戶與逃卒來合。
causeEn: The immediate cause was the collapse of society in Shandong and the vacuum in manpower in the eleventh year of Da Ye. Three campaigns against Liaodong in eight years, together with the registration of households, conscription, public works and the digging of canals, drained the able men of the commanderies again and again; households fled, the fields went untended, the granaries emptied, and famine and epidemic alternated between the Si and Yi rivers and around Mount Tai. These people did not turn into bandits all at once. In the ninth year of Da Ye Yang Xuanggan rebelled at Liyang with a hundred thousand men, Liu Yuanjin rose at Yuhang with tens of thousands, Zhu Xie and Guan Chong in Jinling gathered more than a hundred thousand, and Chen Zhen's three thousand took Xinan Commandery. Once that first wave was beaten down the disorder did not stop; it changed from set-piece rebellion into the pattern of locally entrenched, mobile raiding bandit chiefs, numerous and independent of one another. Wei Qilin's rising is a perfect sample of that pattern: he assumed no royal or imperial title, set up no offices, simply gathered more than ten thousand men as bandits and raided commanderies. By the end of the same year Sima Chang'an had taken Xihai Commandery, the bandit chief Wang Xuba had broken into GaoYang Commandery, and Lu Mingyue with more than a hundred thousand men was raiding between Chen and Ru, all the same sample. The court's answer was conscription and levy: in the eighth month, while Yamen was besieged, it ordered all commanderies to recruit, and in the twelfth month it sent Fan Zigai with the troops of Guanzhong against Jingtuo and Chai Baochang, who could not be broken even after a year. Recruitment and levy emptied the county troops and the granaries further, and once a man in any locality dared to gather a following, runaways, escaped households and deserters would come to him.
impact: 魏騏驎一伙在史料中只是一行字，但它標誌的轉折很重。隋朝末年秩序崩壞有兩種樣子：一種是楊玄感那樣有號令、有攻城器械、一次定勝負的會戰型起義；另一種就是魏騏驎這種不設官署、不圖城池、以劫掠與流動求生的地方起義，而正是後者在615至616年間成為主流。同一年的十一月，賊帥王須拔已能攻破高陽郡；十二月，譙郡人朱粲以數十萬眾寇荊襄、僭稱楚帝，李子通渡淮自號楚王、寇江都，樊子蓋發關中兵討敬盤陀、柴保昌卻經年不能剋。轉過一年，局面更壞：正月雁門人翟松柏起兵靈丘、眾至數萬，二月東海賊盧公暹保于蒼山，四月甄翟兒復號歷山飛、眾十萬轉寇太原、隋朝將軍潘長文討之戰死，七八月馮翊孫華自號總管、九月杜揚州與沈覔敵眾至數萬、十二月林士弘自稱皇帝、國號楚建元太平、攻陷九江與廬陵，隋軍只靠唐公破甄翟兒於西河勉強收復一地。制度上的病竈也見於史載：崔民象以盜賊充斥請勿巡幸、王愛仁以盜賊日盛請還西京，皆被煬帝斬殺；地方以郡兵守城、中央以關中兵救火的老結構，救火的速度永遠追不上新的起事點。615年十月彭城那一萬餘人，是這張網上最先成形的一個節點。
impactEn: The band of Wei Qilin is a single line in the historical record, but the turning point it marks is heavy. There were two shapes to the breakdown of order in the late Sui: the set-piece rebellion of the Yang Xuanggan type, with its commands, its siege engines and one decisive battle; and the local rising of the Wei Qilin type, with no offices, no attempt to hold cities, surviving on plunder and movement. It was the second that became the norm between 615 and 616. Within the same year, in the eleventh month, the bandit chief Wang Xuba was already able to break into GaoYang Commandery; in the twelfth month Zhu Can of Qiaozhou with several hundred thousand men raided Jing and Xiang and usurped the title of Emperor of Chu, Li Zitong crossed the Huai with an unknown multitude, styled himself King of Chu and raided Jiangdu, and Fan Zigai's expedition against Jingtuo and Chai Baochang could not break the enemy in a year. A year later the position was worse still: in the first month Zhai Songbai of Yamen rose at Lingqiu with tens of thousands, in the second month the Donghai bandit Lu Gongxian entrenched himself at Cangshan, in the fourth month Zhen Zhai'er revived the name Lishan Fei with a hundred thousand men, turned on Taiyuan and killed the Sui general Pan Zhangwen, in the seventh and eighth months Sun Hua of Fengyi styled himself Director, in the ninth month Du Yangzhou and Shen Midi reached tens of thousands, and in the twelfth month Lin Shihong proclaimed himself emperor with the state name Chu and the era name Taiping and took JiuJiang and Luling, the Sui forces managing to recover only one district when the Prince of Tang defeated Zhen Zhai'er at Xihe. The disease in the system is also in the record: Cui Minxiang asked that the emperor not go on tour because bandits filled the roads, and Wang Airen asked to return to the western capital because bandits multiplied daily, and both were beheaded. The old structure, local levies holding cities and troops from Guanzhong putting out fires, could never move fast enough to the next point of revolt. The ten thousand men at Pengcheng in the tenth month of 615 were the first of the knots on that net to take shape.
result: 就本場而言，結果是記錄有限而局勢不利。《隋書·煬帝紀》只留下「丁卯，彭城人魏騏驎聚眾萬餘為盜，寇魯郡」一句，之後本紀不再單獨提及這支部眾，既沒有記載官軍何時平定它，也沒有記載首惡的下場——這與同年被記錄的顏宣政（正月破於齊郡）、楊仲緒（二月破斬於北平）形成對照，說明至少在隋廷的視野裡，彭城這一支的威脅排序低於齊郡與北平，其結局很可能是仍在延續，只是不再被單獨點名。歷史記錄在這裡斷了線，恰恰是更有價值的結論：615年十月起，隋朝已經沒有能力逐一平定地方起義，只能靠少數名將率領的可用兵力作定點追剿；而當追剿者本身也在次年折損，隋朝的崩解就只剩下時間問題。617年李淵起兵太原、618年江都與洛陽相繼失守，隨之而來的是瓦崗、竇建德、王世充等割據者瓜分天下；魏騏驎的名字最終沒有在正史的戰爭記錄裡再出現，他這支部眾的餘眾，很可能像同期的李子通、朱粲、甄翟兒那樣，被重新編排進隋末群雄的版圖之中。對後世而言，615年十月丁卯那一日曲阜一帶的兵火，是隋朝由尚能平亂走向平不勝平的一個可以標示的地點。
resultEn: As to the outcome of this war, the record is thin and the situation unfavourable. The annals of Emperor Yang in the Shi Shu preserve only the sentence: on the dingmao day, Pengcheng man Wei Qilin gathered more than ten thousand men as bandits and raided Lu Commandery. The annals do not mention this band again, recording neither when the troops of the state broke it nor the fate of its leader. That stands in contrast with Yan Xuanzheng, defeated at Qijun in the first month, and Yang Zhongxu, cut down at Beiping in the second month, both of the same year; it means that, at least in the court's reckoning, the threat from Pengcheng ranked below those from Qijun and Beiping, and the likeliest outcome is that it went on without being named again. The way the historical record breaks off here is itself the more valuable conclusion. From the tenth month of 615 the Sui no longer had the capacity to settle local risings one by one, and could only rely on the picked troops of a few famous commanders for point pursuits; and when those pursuers too were being worn down in the following year, the fall of the dynasty was only a matter of time. Li Yuan rose at Taiyuan in 617 and Jiangdu and Luoyang fell in 618, and the war lords of Wagang, Dou Jiande and Wang Shichong divided the country among them. The name of Wei Qilin never appears again in the recorded wars of the official histories, and the survivors of his band were most probably reabsorbed, like those of Li Zitong, Zhu Can and Zhen Zhai'er, into the new map of the Sui's end. For posterity, the fighting at Qufu on the dingmao day of the tenth month of 615 marks one place where the Sui passed from being able to put down rebellion to being unable to keep up with it.
